Definition: Eljakim, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eljakim is the name of four Israelites. In 2 Kings 18:18, the text says "there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah." The life behind the name is told on the Eliakim People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eljakim matters because God knows His people by name, and Eljakim is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
